accuracy_expectation: Not measured, and the parts that decide it are unverified. The recommended build targets +/-0.0079 in with Hiwin rails and Gates belt. Here the MGN15 rails are Chinese clones with no stated precision grade (TEN-HIGH says its blocks are pre-loaded; Coavoo states nothing), and the belt is a generic GT2. No measured straightness or block-play data for clone MGN15 rails was found; forum reports are anecdotal and describe a QC lottery. Estimate only: if the rails arrive straight and the blocks have no play, the closed-loop motors and calibration should keep it near the recommended build; a bad rail or loose block would not, and the only way to know is to check the rails with an indicator on arrival.
summary: The same machine as the recommended build, line for line, with each part bought as the cheapest China-made equivalent. Most parts ship from China (AliExpress, Banggood, LCSC) or from China-based sellers on Amazon. Long or heavy items (extrusion, MDF, steel sheet, aluminum stock) come from US sources. Prices are for the parts only: shipping, import duty and sales tax are not included. 27 of the 57 lines are provisional: the exact variant still has to be confirmed at checkout.
tradeoffs: Rails: Chinese clone MGN15 rails, one piece per rail, from Shenzhen sellers on Amazon US (Coavoo 63.78 in for Y, TEN-HIGH 43.31 in for X). Neither states a precision grade, and the blocks only fit their own rails.
Belt and pulleys are generic GT2, not Gates, so steps per inch are calibrated on a long test plot.
The controller changes from the FluidNC 6x to a cheaper ESP32 FluidNC board, so config.yaml and the wiring diagram change. The CAD does not.
The servo is a GDW DS041MG instead of the Hitec HS-5065MG. The printed bracket may need a tweak and the pulse limits need re-tuning on the bench.
Idler height is not stated, so the printed idler spacers may change length.
Shop work the recommended build avoids: tap 8 corner bores M5 in the 4080 beam, saw and tap the 2040 from 78.74 in V-slot bars, cut the MGN9 rail to 3.15 in.
The M5 socket screws are grade 12.9 black alloy steel, not stainless.
risks: Import duty is not in the total. China-origin goods have no de minimis exemption and now pay MFN duty plus the existing Section 301 China tariffs (7.5% or 25%) plus a 12.5% Section 301 tariff in force since 2026-07-24 (USTR, Federal Register 2026-07-28). Estimate only: about 20% to 42% of goods value. On the roughly $228 of goods shipped directly from China (AliExpress, Banggood, LCSC, KST) that is about $46 to $95. If the two Amazon rail packs also ship from China with duty billed to the buyer, add about $139 to $288. AliExpress item pages show no import line and checkout was not viewed.
27 lines are provisional. The exact SKU price or the shipping still needs confirming at checkout, so the total can move either way.

Clone rail quality is a lottery: straightness and block play are not stated, and the Y rail seller has 38 lifetime ratings and no reviews on this listing. Several other sellers also have thin histories (servo, rubber sheet, shielded cable).
Shipping from China is slow and returns to China sellers are rarely practical.
The new controller's 5 V step outputs and the clone buck regulator are unverified; bench-test before connecting the closed-loop drivers and the servo.
groups: Clone MGN15 rails with blocks fitted and generic GT2 belt and idlers (Amazon US, China-based sellers), clone MGN9 and pulleys (AliExpress), StepperOnline closed-loop kits, GDW servo, KST horn
2040 (Amazon) and 4080 (MISUMI USA) extrusion, T-nuts, stainless screws, dowels, inserts and magnets from AliExpress and Amazon China-based sellers
3/4 in MDF, galvanized steel facing and contact cement from US sources; rubber-coated magnets from AliExpress
ESP32 FluidNC board, Mean Well 24 V supply, XKB switches, drag chains, cable, enclosure, E-stop, buck, connectors and ferrules (AliExpress, LCSC, Banggood, Amazon)
1/4 and 5/16 in 6061 plate, 4 x 4 x 1/4 in angle, 1 x 1 in bar from Speedy Metals (US); China sells metric sizes only

lines.vendor: Bolang-cnc Store (AliExpress), maker of the board (bolangsk.cn)
lines.notes: Not the 6x, so firmware/config.yaml and the wiring diagram change; no CAD change. The board runs FluidNC (the maker publishes a FluidNC config and schematic). 4 external step/dir ports through a 74HC245 at 5 V, no enable output to the drivers, 3 limit inputs, start/hold/reset inputs, buffered 5 V PWM for the servo. Not verified: that the buffer reliably takes the ESP32's 3.3 V and drives the CL42T step inputs. Bench check before wiring the motors. The 6x bought direct from Elecrow (Shenzhen) would be $49.00 + $15.14 duty-paid shipping = $64.14. Import: Item page shows no import charge or tax line; checkout not viewed (no login) Shipping of $7.69 not included.
